classification.difficultyReason: Combine four different decrease multipliers and interpret the resulting multiplier as an overall percentage decrease.

content.prompt: Since a new ‘Fitness for Freedom’ program was introduced in a community, the number of people classified as overweight in that community has been falling. In four successive years, the number of overweight people fell by $4.8\%$, $7.1\%$, $10.5\%$ and $6.2\%$, respectively. Find, correct to two decimal places, the percentage decrease over the four-year period.

answer.worked:
The successive decrease multipliers are $0.952$, $0.929$, $0.895$ and $0.938$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Combined multiplier}&=0.952\times0.929\times0.895\times0.938\\\text{Combined multiplier}&=0.74246936008\\\text{Percentage decrease}&=(1-0.74246936008)\times100\%\\\text{Percentage decrease}&\approx25.75\%\end{align*}$$
